svg.title: TNUSRB SI 2015 Q120 source diagram and four labelled visual choices
svg.desc: Archive page 14 prints no verbal question. The source figure is a circular outline with overlapping angular black lines and a question mark. Choices: A is an arch over a pointed V shape with crossing slants; B is a quarter-round wedge with an inner diagonal; C is a quarter-round shape with a rectangular corner and right-curving outer boundary; D is a pointed roof, horizontal middle bar and lower U-shaped curve. Choice identity is not inferred from answer key. This is an editorial visual tracing from coaching archive, not the official TNUSRB booklet.

g.text: The archived page supplies only this visual, not the printed instruction.

svg.text: Unverified figure tracing from the source-numbered 2015 coaching archive, printed page 14 · Ungraded
